SELECT rtks_skill.id, rtks_skill.resource_id, rtks_skill.system_id, rtks_skill.category_id, rtks_skill.content, rtks_skill.courses, rtks_skill.create_time, rtks_skill.update_time, rtks_skill_category.content category, rtks_skill_system.content system FROM rtks_skill LEFT JOIN rtks_skill_category ON rtks_skill.category_id = rtks_skill_category.resource_id LEFT JOIN rtks_skill_system ON rtks_skill.system_id = rtks_skill_system.resource_id
rtks_skill.resource_id = #{id}
